Name: SVE-Original pixel style portrait of Victor without the slicked back hair
Author: Nathan1048157970
Description:
(The following content is translated by the translation software. If you don't understand it, you can try to copy the Chinese language to the translation software and re-translate it, which may be more accurate.)
​
with
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5267?tab=files]Nayrie's SVE Portrait Mod[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23943]Nayrie's SVE Portrait Mod for Victor and Olivia's winter wear[/url]
Two mods inside the Sprites matching Victor's portrait.
​
Changed Victor's hairstyle, skin tone, face shape and expression.
More in line with my personal image of rich kids.
[s]Although not sure why this hairstyle looks so much like Sebastian's brother....
​[/s]
I personally only played SVE until the end of spring, so I haven't tested the beach and winter clothes, but it should be no problem.
​
-- -- -- -- -- --
​
Installation method:
Copy all PNG images to the Portrait folder of the SVE mod and select Paste Overlay.
Specific folder address: Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\Portraits\Victor
​
The same goes for Sprites. After modding from the MOD interface of the two authors, paste the walk diagram belonging to Victor into the OverworldSprites folder of SVE.
Specific folder location: Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Victor

安装方法：
将所有的PNG图片复制到SVE模组的肖像文件夹中，并选择粘贴覆盖。
具体文件夹地址：Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\Portraits\Victor


行走图也是同理。从这两个作者的MOD界面下完MOD后，把属于维克多的行走图粘贴到SVE的OverworldSprites文件夹中即可。
具体文件夹位置：Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Victor
